purchases.q: How can we track our purchase requests and approval processes?

orders.q: Can we monitor the status of our orders and delivery processes?

payments.q: How can we control pending payment requests and payment processes?

quotes.q: Can we view supplier quotations and purchasing comparisons?
quotes.a: Received quotations, supplier prices, and purchasing histories are securely recorded and can be easily compared and analyzed.

stages.q: How can we track the current stage of processes and identify delayed tasks?
stages.a: With Prizma FLOW, all process steps, waiting times, and responsible users can be viewed in real time.

reports.q: Can we report our operational and financial data?

dashboards.q: Can we create customized reports and dashboards for management?

hr.q: How can we manage employee records, timesheets, leave, and payroll processes?

hrReports.q: Can we report personnel costs and human resources data?

inventory.q: How can we control inventory and material requirements?

about.title: 21 years building ERP for construction
about.subtitle: With over 21 years of industry expertise, Prizma is a comprehensive ERP, business process management, financial management, and reporting platform designed specifically for the construction industry.
about.yearsBody: From the initial request to the final progress payment, Prizma is developed in line with the real workflow of the construction industry, bringing together field and office processes on a single platform.
about.storyBody1: Prizma is more than just software; it is a management platform built on over 21 years of field experience, real project requirements, and the dynamics of the construction industry.
about.storyBody2: Developed through a detailed analysis of the challenges faced in budgeting, procurement, finance, human resources, and project management, Prizma has evolved into an integrated solution that enables businesses to manage all their operations from a single platform.

mission.label: Mission
mission.title: Make construction management effortless
mission.body: At Prizma, our mission is to empower construction companies through digital transformation by simplifying complex business processes, increasing operational efficiency, and enabling smarter decision-making.

vision.label: Vision
vision.title: The ERP standard for construction
vision.body: Our vision is to become the leading digital transformation and ERP platform for the global construction industry. By combining innovative technologies, data-driven insights, and industry expertise, we empower organizations to optimize operations, improve decision-making, and achieve sustainable growth.

about.offerTitle: An integrated digital management solution that manages all construction business processes on a single platform
about.storyBody3: Continuously enhanced through experience gained from real projects, Prizma accelerates processes, strengthens operational control, and provides managers with powerful analytical tools to make the right decisions at the right time.
about.storyBody4: Today, more than 5,000 users manage their daily operations faster, more transparently, and more efficiently through Prizma’s reliable infrastructure.
about.storyBody5: By closely following the evolving needs of the industry, we continue to develop stronger, more flexible, and smarter solutions with every new project.

process.author: Prizma Team
process.title: Process Module
process.excerpt: Operational efficiency built on three core processes: material request, purchase request and payment request.
process.lead: Prizma Flow's Process module is built on three core processes that raise operational efficiency: material request, purchase request and payment request.

sections.heading: The material request process
sections.body: The process starts when a department defines the material or service it needs. The warehouse checks stock: if the material is available it is delivered directly; if not, it is routed to a purchase request.

sections.heading: Purchase and payment processes
sections.body: The purchasing department collects supplier quotes within budget and criteria — at least two companies for low-value purchases and at least three for high-value ones. After approval and technical review, the process moves to the payment schedule. Customizable screens — inbox, completed payments, contracts and order tracking — ensure resources are used effectively.

erp.author: Prizma Team
erp.title: ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) Module
erp.excerpt: Control inventory, stock and material movements from one center, with accounting entries created automatically.
erp.lead: The ERP module is a comprehensive program that lets businesses control inventory, stock and material movements from a single center while simplifying process management.

sections.heading: Key features
sections.body: Material management tracks quantity, unit and amount centrally. Material vouchers record consumption, scrap, transfer, production entry, counting and assignment. Warehouse transfers automate movements between warehouses and produce inventory and cost-center reports. Thanks to accounting integration, accounting entries are created automatically.

sections.heading: Benefits for businesses
sections.body: Operational efficiency, cost savings, real-time traceability, fast decisions, detailed analysis, flexibility, time savings, higher profitability and data security. Accurate stock management raises the profit margin and provides a competitive edge.

accounting.author: Prizma Team
accounting.title: General Accounting Module
accounting.excerpt: Manage all financial transactions from one platform: income and expense, bank and cash movements, purchase and sales invoices.
accounting.lead: Prizma's General Accounting module lets you manage all of your company's financial transactions from a single platform. Income and expenses, bank and cash movements, and purchase and sales invoices are recorded completely and transparently.

sections.heading: Comprehensive voucher management
sections.body: The module supports more than 25 voucher types — transfer, bank, cash, collection, payment, offset, interbank transfer, accrual, advance, and purchase and sales invoices. Every transaction is posted to the right account, giving full transparency across daily, monthly and annual financial processes.

sections.heading: What it brings to your business
sections.body: Bringing every accounting process onto one platform increases efficiency and reduces both error risk and operational cost. Its web-based structure lets you reach your data from anywhere through a user-friendly interface.

reports.author: Prizma Team
reports.title: Reports Module
reports.excerpt: Track financial and operational performance in real time: cumulative and pivot reports, management reports and a dashboard.
reports.lead: Prizma's Reports module lets businesses monitor their financial and operational performance in real time. It enables comprehensive evaluation from every angle and speeds up decision-making.

sections.heading: Four core components
sections.body: Cumulative income-expense reports present a period's income and expenses in a single table. Pivot reports break data into categories for detailed analysis. Management reports show all data numerically and graphically together. The dashboard gathers critical information on a single screen.

sections.heading: Business benefits
sections.body: The system delivers time savings, faster decisions, customizable reports, financial control and comprehensive analysis — supporting higher efficiency and sustainable growth.

hrm.author: Prizma Team
hrm.title: Human Resources Module (HRM)
hrm.excerpt: Manage employee data, timesheets, payroll, overtime and leave from one central place.
hrm.lead: Prizma's Human Resources (HRM) module simplifies employee management. It brings personnel data, attendance records, payroll calculations, overtime and leave processes together in one central place.

sections.heading: Personnel management
sections.body: The module keeps all employee records — ID, social security, address and contact details — organized and accessible, so worker documentation stays current and easy to reach.

sections.heading: Payroll, performance and data integration
sections.body: The system manages salaries, overtime and leave days, and makes performance and overtime-cost control easier. Data is bidirectionally compatible with Excel, so import and export are flexible.
